entry.title: Slay the Spire II v1.0.0
entry.content:
# Slay the Spire II 1.0 Release!
**Huge shoutout to all the contributors! This is a product of love from:** @dlueben1 @cjmang @Lyxn-M @Terairk
**Thank you to everyone who helped playtest this, report bugs, provide support, and contribute ideas!**
> [!WARNING] > Slay the Spire II is an early access and receives frequent updates. As such, while this mod is fully playable, there is a chance that bugs can slip past us when the devs do their regular game updates. Please report any bugs you find and thanks for your patience!
# Changelist
## Characters and Ascensions
- Ascensions can now be configured as **individual modifiers**, globally or separately for each character. - This means that instead of the vanilla behavior of "all ascensions up to Ascension X", you can have individual Ascension modifiers enabled! - Added **Ascension Down** items, allowing selected Ascension modifiers to be disabled as items arrive during a run. ([#169](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/169), [#181](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/181); fixes [#46](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/issues/46), [#135](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/issues/135), and [#147](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/issues/147)) - Added support for up to **five custom characters** alongside the five built-in characters. - Installed character IDs can be found under **Archipelago Settings -> Archipelago**. ([#176](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/176))
> [!CAUTION] > Modded characters are supported on a best-effort basis. Test custom characters before using them in a long multiworld, especially if they substantially change game systems!
> [!WARNING] > Archipelago logic does not account for Ascension Down items
## Ancient, Relic, and Starter Progression
- Added **Progressive Ancient** items and optional **Neow Sanity**. ([#177](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/177), [#207](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/207), [#73](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/issues/73)) - Ancient rewards can be configured to appear as a three-choice reward in the Archipelago loot screen or in their original locations at the start of each act. - You can now **randomize the Ancient Relic pool**. - Balanced: Keep Ancient Relic Pools vanilla - Chaos: Ancient Relic Pools are randomized within their Act - True Chaos: Ancient Relic Pools are randomized across Acts 2 and 3 for all non-Neow Ancients. - Relic rewards can be configured to use a coupon system. The first configurable number of Relic items are available immediately; later Relics require rewards earned from Elites, treasure chests, Black Star, etc. ([#223](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/223)) - Earned rewards are banked, so fighting Elites remains valuable even before the corresponding item arrives. Recommend setting this option to 2 so elites remain valuable. - Added optional **Progressive Starter Card** and **Progressive Starter Relic** items. Each restores the normal starter first, then grants the corresponding Ancient upgrade. - These options *require Floor Checks*. - Added an option to keep a winning character's remaining checks locked instead of automatically releasing them on victory. - This is an option to incentivize players to fight Elites rather than "race to the top" and for those 100% no release syncs. - Various Loot Menu UI changes have been made, including bug fixes and adding tooltips to Relic and potion rewards. (fixes [#192](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/issues/192) and [#201](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/issues/201))
> [!TIP] > Progressive Starter Card and Progressive Starter Relic can make the early game significantly harder. Archipelago logic currently doesn't account for this.
## Shops, Gold, and Filler Items
- Gold Sanity rewards now better match Slay the Spire II's natural combat and Elite rewards, including the effects of the Poverty Ascension modifier. ([#196](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/196); fixes [#186](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/issues/186) and [#191](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/issues/191)) - Added various buffs as filler items with configurable filler weights, including free card plays, Strength, Dexterity, Plating, Buffer, Vigor, Artifact, Thorns, Friendship, card upgrades, card removal, and additional card rewards. ([#178](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/178), [#225](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/225)) - Shop Sanity is here! This feature supports configurable colored-card, neutral-card, relic, potion, and progressive card-removal slots. AP inventory has its own shop page and configurable fixed or tiered prices. ([#230](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/230), [#232](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/232); fixes [#180](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/issues/180), [#188](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/issues/188), [#224](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/224); fixes [#218](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/issues/218), and [#190](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/issues/190))
> [!WARNING] > Shopsanity is a very complicated feature, and while we've worked very hard to stabilize it, there may be edge cases yet uncaught. Please report any bugs you find to our Discord or GitHub! > > Additionally, Archipelago logic does not account for the Shop Sanity cost mode.
> [!NOTE] > Currently, filler items are entirely consumed at the start of your next turn of combat. In the future we will buffer this system so that players who have been offline for a while don't waste all the filler buffs on the first combat of a floor.
## Client and Interface
- Reworked the main and pause menus with new options and QoL changes (too many PRs to count) - New settings include an Archipelago loot-screen keybind, configurable notification options, and a selectable Ancient announcer. ([#168](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/168)) - Improved connection-screen keyboard navigation: Tab and Shift+Tab cycle through controls, Enter activates buttons, and Escape closes the screen safely. ([#208](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/208); fixes [#67](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/issues/67)) - Added a top-bar display for the current act's Progressive Rest and Progressive Smith unlocks. (fixes [#210](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/issues/210)) - Reworked the Archipelago reward overlay so it composes correctly with the map, deck, card piles, native rewards, shops, and treasure rooms. Tooltips and notifications now render at the correct size and layer. ([#222](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/222); fixes [#185](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/issues/185) and [#220](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/issues/220))
## Official Website
The Slay the Spire II Archipelago Client now has an official [Website](https://sts2ap.net)!
Most importantly we now have an **Online YAML Builder/Wizard** that *greatly* simplifies setting up a player's YAML. Please check it out [here](https://sts2ap.net/#/builder)!
> [!NOTE] > The YAML Builder is still in development and doesn't support certain features like starting hints, local/non-local items, etc. Expect more features very soon, as it will update *outside of the mod's update schedule*.
## Beta Branch Compatibility
- One client build now supports the default public game branch and provides experimental compatibility with newer beta branches. The default public branch remains recommended. ([#205](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/205))
> [!CAUTION] > This incredible feature is possible thanks to the pioneering efforts of @Terairk but please be careful when using the Beta Branch, *especially* for asyncs/long-running sessions. MegaCrit updates the Beta Branch of StS II very frequently, and while we'll do our best to keep support for Beta and Public, we can't predict our availability and how damaging/complicated their changes to the Beta Branch will be. > > So while this is very awesome, be warned to use this at your own risk. > > If you're not familiar with Archipelago, Slay the Spire II, or navigating issues during a Multiworld, we **strongly recommend the Default Public Version**.
## Bug Fixes & Reliability Updates
- Received items are queued and processed on the game thread, fixing race-condition crashes and unreliable item handling. ([#221](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/221); fixes [#154](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/issues/154) and [#194](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/issues/194)) - AP card rewards now use the game's standard reward flow, and enter the combat draw pile when claimed mid-combat. - Relics like Lasting Candy now function correctly without double-counting. ([#208](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/208)) - Underdocks is available without its vanilla Timeline unlock. - Fixed character-select crashes, AP reward-screen softlocks, missing filler weights, tracker inconsistencies, Campfire Sanity checks, Shop Sanity inventory behavior, Progressive Ancient generation, and Death Link timer synchronization. ([#181](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/181), [#224](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/224), [#225](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/225), [#231](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/231), [#233](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/233)) - Added compatibility for APWorlds from `0.5.3` and earlier, including legacy Ascension values and saves. - This should allow players to finish their existing Archipelago games without interruption. ([#228](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/228) and [#229](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/229)) - While untested, this mod should now be compatible with **MacOS and Linux** - This is because we've removed the custom Windows-only log window in favor of RitsuLib's logging tools.
> [!TIP] > If you've successfully run the mod on MacOS, Linux, or SteamOS, please reach out and let us know how it went!
# Mod Information
## Pre-Requisites
- **Your host MUST use Archipelago Client v0.6.7+**. - This version of the mod is intended to be used for **v0.107.1** of Slay the Spire II - While we have experimental support for the public beta branch, we recommend **the "Default Public/Main Version"** of the game to most players. Since the beta branch is updated more frequently and is more volatile, it's less likely to be bug-free. Please use it at your own risk. However numerous players have used it just fine, @Terairk is the maintainer for this and he mostly develops here. - We will do our best to keep up with game updates as they release, so please be patient when encountering issues.
## Installing the Mod from Steam Workshop (Recommended)
1. Ensure that you have [RitsuLib](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3747602295) installed. The easiest way to obtain it is from Steam Workshop. 2. Subscribe to the [Slay the Spire II Archipelago Client](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3748826296) on Steam Workshop. 3. Make sure that any other unnecessary mods are turned off, unless you're trying to use a specific modded character for your Archipelago session. 4. Start the game
## Manually Installing the Mod from GitHub
1. Ensure that you have [RitsuLib](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3747602295) installed. The easiest way to obtain it is from Steam Workshop. 2. Download the "sts2-client.zip" from the [Releases](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/releases/latest) section of the Repo 3. Go to your Slay the Spire II directory (In Steam, click "Browse Local Files") 4. If a folder called `mods` does not exist, create it 5. Unzip the **contents** of `sts2-client.zip` into `mods`
- If you've done this step correctly, your directory structure should look like this: `/<slay-the-spire-2-local-files>/mods/Archipelago/` and the contents of that folder should be a bunch of `.dll` files and a `.pck` file (there may be more files too, please don't touch anything in this folder)
6. Start the game
### Additional Steps for **Hosts**
7. Download `spire2.apworld` 8. Open your Archipelago Launcher 9. Click "Install APWorld" 10. Select `spire2.apworld` in the file dialog that pops up 11. **Restart the Archipelago Launcher** 12. Now you should be able to properly host/generate an Archipelago Session with StS 2
- If you want to use `archipelago.gg` to host the game, generate it locally first following the steps above, then upload the `.zip` file from the `output` folder in your Archipelago installation
> [!IMPORTANT] > You need to use Archipelago Version 0.6.7+ and CANNOT use earlier versions of Archipelago with this mod!
## Known Issues/Limitations
- Switching Slay the Spire II branches during an active run may make that run's checkpoint incompatible with the other branch.
## Common Q&A
### Will this mess with my unmodded Save File?
No.
### I installed the AP World but it's not working
Is your Archipelago Launcher v0.6.7 or later? If not it **won't work**.

entry.title: OpenTTD v1.4.1r2
entry.content:
# OpenTTD Archipelago 2.0.0
The launcher era. This game is now a **plugin** for the [Multiworld Launcher](https://github.com/solida1987/Multiworld-Launcher) (3.0.1 or newer) — see **INSTALL.md** on this release.
- No in-game server login: the launcher owns the session, Join AP connects straight away - Standalone mode: pre-generated solo seeds, progress kept per seed - Auto-install and updates through the launcher - NewGRF guard: the launcher checks your sets against the seed before play - YAML builder with all 108 options - DeathLink both ways
| Asset | What it is | |---|---| | `openttd_archipelago-1.0.0.londonplugin` | The plugin you add to the launcher | | `game_package.zip` | The full game — the launcher installs this for you, or download it by hand | | `game_manifest.json` | Per-file checksums of the package | | `openttd.apworld` | For whoever hosts the multiworld | | `INSTALL.md` | The full walkthrough | | `openttd-archipelago-legacy-v1.4.1-win64.zip` | The old pre-launcher build |
The legacy build has its own in-game Archipelago client and needs no launcher. It is discontinued and gets no further updates, but it rides along on every release so it stays one download away. Its source is the `v1.4.1` tag.

entry.title: Divinity Original Sin 2 v0.8.0
entry.content:
New: - Act keys are now implemented. These are keys that need to be collected before you can leave their respective act. The number of these keys needed are set in the yaml. - Region barriers have been added. When enabled, large barriers will stop you from entering certain regions unless you have their respective region unlock item. - Reaper's Eye has barriers cutting off Fort Joy, The Hollow Marshes, and North-east Reaper's Eye. - Reaper's Coast has barriers cutting off Driftwood, Reaper's Bluffs, Cloisterwood, The Meadows, The Cullwoods, Stonegarden, Paradise Downs, The Blackpits, and Bloodmoon Island. - The Nameless Isle is unchanged when region barriers are enabled. - Arx has barriers cutting off Arx and the Tomb of Lucian.
Changes/Bugfixes: - "Bloodmoon Island: Dead Black Ring Destroyer (266, 437)" has been removed as it prematurely sent a check when loading into Reaper's Coast. - The ads in The Great Guardian fight are now checks. - Logic now utilizes the rule builder, it's a bit better here and there and far easier to edit and improve. entry.title: Halo The Master Chief Collection v1.2.0
entry.content:
# What's new ## Skullsanity - items grant the ability to turn skulls on or off, and skull pickups in levels are locations - currently the skull pickups are not toggleable to prevent generation issues due to too few locations - skull items have 4 settings 1. off: skulls can be freely turned on or off 2. non-scoring: non scoring skulls are forced off and you must receive the skull item to be able to turn them on 3. all: non-scoring skulls work as they do in the non-scoring option. scoring skulls are forced on and you must recieve the skull item to be able to turn them off 4. inverted: all skulls are forced off. you must recieve their item to be able to turn them on - when skullsanity is set to all mission completion is logically set behind receiving a yaml configurable number of scoring skulls. - locked skulls are shown as locked in the UI
## Chapters (Chapters are what im calling the parts in a mission where black bars come across the top and bottom and a title diologue is shown in the bottom) - reaching chapters in a mission sends a location - these locations are always on - these locations do not take skullsanity into consideration for logic, if the mission is playable all chapters are logically reachable - Known Bug: When a chapter is shown in a skippable cutscene skipping the cutscene will cause the location to not send

entry.title: Metroid: Samus Returns v0.3.0
entry.content:
I've been sitting on this one because I wanted to do some logic stuff, but haven't found the motivation for that so I'll go ahead and release the updated patcher features since they've been waiting for ages.
## Game changes * Updated Open Samus Returns Rando to 3.6.1 * Added information about the seed and patcher on the title screen * The intro text is now skipped * The whole map is revealed from the start * Updated the text that appears when you get all Metroid DNA without having the hatchling * Added spoiler log to the credits * Items show roughly in the order logic expected you to collect them * Solo Plasma Beam does more damage to Steel Orbs * Spazer and Plasma Beam projectiles no longer shoot through breakable blocks without Wave Beam * The area item collection percentage is now correct and counts all items and all Metroids (the percentage on the main menu still doesn't work)
## Options changes * Added Reverse Area 8 option * When enabled, the wall from Hatchling Room to Queen Arena is removed * The queen won't be there if you come from that direction - you only fight her if you drop in from Queen Arena Access * Added Fusion Suit cosmetic option
## Client changes * Client now shows a progress bar as it patches the game
## Logic changes * Fixed escape rule for Surface: Cavern Cavity * Fixed bomb requirement for A2: Interior Intersection Terminal - Tunnel pickup
## Universal Tracker changes * Rule explanations now show trick requirements by name (instead of generically as 'sequence breaks') * Rule explanations now show the requirement to escape from points of no return (no change to actual requirements shown, just that they're for escaping is now explicit)
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/lilDavid/AP-SamusReturns/compare/0.2.2...0.3.0

entry.title: Slay the Spire II v1.0.1
entry.content:
> [!WARNING] > Both Slay the Spire II and this Archipelago Mod are in active development. As such, while this _is_ playable, expect there to be bugs and limited features. We appreciate your playtesting!
See the [1.0.0 release notes](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/releases/tag/1.0.0) for additional details about the big changes introduced in this major update.
# Changelist
## AP World Changelist - Logic now accounts for Progressive Starter Cards and Relics. You will hopefully get them consistently earlier in the run now. - Fixed **UT support** by making UT recognize the shuffle all card rewards option (this should fix the UT-fuzz issues) - Added Item Groups to make hinting easier such as Character Unlocks or 'Ironclad Campfire Upgrades' - Fix some fields not being pickled or not having correct default options
## Game Client Mod Changelist - Some slight performance improvements in some areas. - Now **correctly handles disconnects** and ensures the connect button works on disconnecting and reconnecting - Checks from a slightly bigger disconnect are now queued offline and sent when you reconnect.
# Mod Information
## Pre-Requisites
- **Your host MUST use Archipelago Client v0.6.7+**. - This version of the mod is intended to be used for **v0.107.1** of Slay the Spire II - While we have experimental support for the public beta branch **v0.111.0**, we recommend **the "Default Public/Main Version"** of the game to most players. Since the beta branch is updated more frequently and is more volatile, it's less likely to be bug-free. Please use it at your own risk. However numerous players have used it just fine, @Terairk is the maintainer for this and he mostly develops here. - We will do our best to keep up with game updates as they release, so please be patient when encountering issues.
## Installing the Mod from Steam Workshop (Recommended)
1. Ensure that you have [RitsuLib](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3747602295) installed. The easiest way to obtain it is from Steam Workshop. 2. Subscribe to the [Slay the Spire II Archipelago Client](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3748826296) on Steam Workshop. 3. Make sure that any other unnecessary mods are turned off, unless you're trying to use a specific modded character for your Archipelago session. 4. Start the game
## Manually Installing the Mod from GitHub
1. Ensure that you have [RitsuLib](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3747602295) installed. The easiest way to obtain it is from Steam Workshop. 2. Download the "sts2-client.zip" from the [Releases](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/releases/latest) section of the Repo 3. Go to your Slay the Spire II directory (In Steam, click "Browse Local Files") 4. If a folder called `mods` does not exist, create it 5. Unzip the **contents** of `sts2-client.zip` into `mods`
- If you've done this step correctly, your directory structure should look like this: `/<slay-the-spire-2-local-files>/mods/Archipelago/` and the contents of that folder should be a bunch of `.dll` files and a `.pck` file (there may be more files too, please don't touch anything in this folder)
6. Start the game
### Additional Steps for **Hosts**
7. Download `spire2.apworld` 8. Open your Archipelago Launcher 9. Click "Install APWorld" 10. Select `spire2.apworld` in the file dialog that pops up 11. **Restart the Archipelago Launcher** 12. Now you should be able to properly host/generate an Archipelago Session with StS 2
- If you want to use `archipelago.gg` to host the game, generate it locally first following the steps above, then upload the `.zip` file from the `output` folder in your Archipelago installation
> [!IMPORTANT] > You need to use Archipelago Version 0.6.7+ and CANNOT use earlier versions of Archipelago with this mod!
## Known Issues/Limitations
- Switching Slay the Spire II branches during an active run may make that run's checkpoint incompatible with the other branch.
## Common Q&A
### Will this mess with my unmodded Save File?
No.
### I installed the AP World but it's not working
Is your Archipelago Launcher v0.6.7 or later? If not it **won't work**.

entry.title: Mega Man Zero 3 v0.3.1
entry.content:
New feature, level access items! This changes is very a lot of how the game plays, so I would check out the [full README](https://github.com/brodieberger/MMZero3Archipelago/) so you know what to expect. Please report any bugs as usual!
# New Features
- Every stage is now locked behind its own access item. You start in the Resistance Base with no stages accessible. The first access item is guaranteed to be early local, so check around the base and talk to NPCs.
- There's a modified mission select screen, which is visually very WIP. It works, and everything it tells you is correct, but it does not look finished yet. - Boss portraits are in groups of four like before, but now you can tab between the pages with left and right on the d-pad (the shoulder buttons work too). - Hovering a level tells you its name, how many of its disks you have found, whether it's LOCKED / OPEN / CLEARED, and your best rank in it. - Picking a level you have already beaten asks you how you want to run it. EXPLORE is the vanilla revisit for picking up disks you missed. RETRY MISSION plays the level as a real mission again, so the boss is back and you get another shot at the A+ rank check. - There are now Story Progress items in the pool. Collecting one makes the game believe you completed the first intermission (Missile Factory), collecting the second makes the game believe you completed the second intermission (Copy X). This is kind of a bandaid fix, since all it really does is advance NPC dialogue so you can get the checks from them. It will be removed later.
# Known bugs
- The level select screen is visually early access. It works, and everything it tells you is correct, but it does not look finished yet. Specifically:
- The page with Area X-2 on it draws three portraits instead of four. The fourth one is there and selectable, and the name and info at the bottom are right, but the portrait doesn't render correctly.
- The last page is invisible. The following four levels (Derelict Spacecraft, Missile Factory, Sub Arcadia and Weil's Lab) have no boss portrait art yet. But the text at the bottom of the screen is correct and the levels are selectable as normal.
- Talking to the operator in the command room takes you straight to the stage select. Looks sort of strange and will be fixed later.

entry.title: Librarian Tidy Up the Arcane Library v2.0.1
entry.content:
## Librarian-AP v2.0.1
Three bug fixes from 2.0.0 reports. **All three are retroactive: if you are mid-run on a 2.0.0 seed, update the mod and reconnect, and the items, checks and goal you were missing will come through. You do not need a new seed.**
## Bug Fixes
### Items received at connect went missing
The first items a seed gives you arrive in the same instant you connect, before the client has finished loading the item list from the server. Their names came back as "Unknown", and since items are applied by name, those ones applied to nothing and were gone. Reloading fixed things only because reconnecting makes the server send everything again.
The client now waits for the name before it counts an item as delivered.
**If this happened to you, reconnect to your slot and the missing items will apply.**
### The goal did not send on the full goal
Every goal now sends off the row count, `full` included. A run that finished its last row in an earlier session also sends the goal now, instead of waiting for a row completion that already happened.
### "Complete N Books" checks never sent
In BookSanity, the book milestone checks never fired in any seed. The client was never reading them.
They now send, and they count every book you have correctly shelved across the whole run rather than just the current session, so loading a save no longer starts the count over.
These checks were called `Complete N Books` and are now `Correctly shelve N books`. Seeds generated on 2.0.0 are not affected and will keep the old name in your tracker. The only thing that needs updating is a YAML that names these locations in `exclude_locations`, `priority_locations` or plando, and only for new seeds.
## Also in this release
Sixteen leftover diagnostic hooks are gone. Four of them were failing to register on every launch and showing up as errors in logs.
## Updating
> Extract the zip and drop `Librarian/` into your Steam install (overwrite). Drop the > included `librarian.apworld` into your Archipelago `custom_worlds/` folder. Requires > game build 1.0.12 or newer. The title screen top-right should read `LibAP v2.0.1`.
**Continuing a 2.0.0 run:** you only need the mod. Your existing seed is fine and the host does not need to change anything.
**Generating a new seed:** you need the new `librarian.apworld` as well.
## If something breaks
Send `crash_trace.log` (the header should read `mod=2.0.1`), the last ~200 lines of `UE4SS.log`, your YAML's `Librarian:` section, and one line on what you were doing.

entry.title: Librarian Tidy Up the Arcane Library v2.0.2
entry.content:
## Librarian-AP v2.0.2
A goal option, a new default, and a fix to what lands on your checks.
**Existing 2.0.1 runs are unaffected: you do not need a new seed to update the mod.** The new options only apply to seeds generated from here on.
## `goal: custom` now works in every unlock mode
Custom used to be rejected in `individual_series_unlocks` and `booksanity`. It works in all three now.
```yaml goal: custom custom_goal_row_count: 200 # progressive_unlocks / individual_series_unlocks custom_goal_book_count: 1500 # booksanity counts books instead extra_series_percent: 10 ```
BookSanity counts books rather than rows, so it has its own `custom_goal_book_count`. The default of 1500 is about half the library, which puts it close to a floor goal in size. Worth knowing: 400 rows hold 3072 books, so a row-shaped number here is a far shorter run than it looks.
**A custom book goal is also the quickest way to play BookSanity.** The full goal is slow to generate at ~3072 items; a custom goal takes about a second.
### The seed is trimmed to fit your goal
If you set your goal row count to 200, only 200 series are added to the pool, unlike before where all 400 were added. This makes it so you no longer have 200 extra checks sent when you complete your goal, and other players dont have tons of checks trapped behind your goal.
So a custom goal now trims the library down to roughly what your goal needs, plus `extra_series_percent` slack (default 10%). Sections past that leave the pool entirely. A 200-row seed keeps about 222 rows instead of 400, and the surplus drops from 200 checks to around 22.
`extra_series_percent` is one dial with two effects. Lower trims harder and is kinder to a multiworld; higher gives you more choice over *which* rows you finish rather than a forced march through nearly all of them. Sections are always kept whole, so the real total lands on the next section boundary rather than exactly on your percentage.
## Books now stay hidden until their shelf is open
`only_unward_shelfable_books` defaults to **on**. A book you can pick up is now always one you can shelve where it belongs.
With it off, books arrive grabbable whether or not their bookcase is open, and to collect everything you may need to shelf a series, then replace it with a different series on the same shelf, working through what you hold using the shelves you have. That is a real way to play, and it is still there if you want it. It just is not what most people expect on a first run.
## Bug fix: traps no longer crowd out your magic
When a seed is smaller than the item pool, the surplus comes off the optional items. The order was wrong: magic went first, so a smaller goal could strip `Progressive Insight` and friends while keeping every `Fatigue` trap. BookSanity was worse: what survived came down to where an item happened to sit in a list.
Traps are dropped first now, then Mastery, then bag capacity, with base magic kept longest. A 200-row seed goes from 60 useful items and 10 traps to 70 useful and no traps.
## Updating
> Extract the zip and drop `Librarian/` into your Steam install (overwrite). Drop the > included `librarian.apworld` into your Archipelago `custom_worlds/` folder. Requires > game build 1.0.12 or newer. The title screen top-right should read `LibAP v2.0.2`.
**Continuing a 2.0.1 run:** you only need the mod, and the host does not need to change anything.
**Generating a new seed:** you need the new `librarian.apworld` as well.
## If something breaks
Send `crash_trace.log` (the header should read `mod=2.0.2`), the last ~200 lines of `UE4SS.log`, your YAML's `Librarian:` section, and one line on what you were doing.

Sly 2 Archipelago implementation. For setup instructions, check out the [README](https://github.com/NikolajDanger/APSly2/blob/main/README.md).
## Changes ### Features - Tasksanity is here! Adds a new `tasksanity` option, which makes every task of every mission its own check. Adds 278 new locations. - Increased the maximum number of Clockwerk parts in the pool to 500. I also added a bunch more silly named Clockwerk parts. - The sell value of loot and treasures can be randomized with a new range of options. - Added the `dynamic_loot_tables` option, which makes pickpocketing favor checks you haven't gotten yet (you can still get unlucky. It's just slightly less annoying). - The `/loot_table` command now outputs in color, showing more clearly which loot is in logic and which are checked. - Pickpocket checks are now on the UT map page (just in the Sly 2 client, not in a standalone UT client).
### Bug fixes and improvements - Fixed the main problem of last release: Clockwerk parts count not being recalculated on reconnect. - The duration of some of the traps has been increased. - Added a `/trace` command, for diagnosing crashes as they're happening. Should absolutely not be turned on during normal play; the log file grows very quickly. - Several generation fixes. - Fixed guards not spawning with the correct randomized loot. This is like the third time, but I'm certain it's right this time. - Fixed "&" displaying incorrectly in-game. - The client now fully resets when connecting to a different slot.

entry.title: Kirby & The Amazing Mirror v0.3.1rc1
entry.content:
## v0.3.1
### New Features - Added a new option: `enemy_health_multiplier`. Scale all enemies' health values between 50% to 500% of the original game. It defaults to 100% which matches the original game (Issue #880). - Added `random_color_per_room` to Starting Kirby Color. It chooses an initial supported palette at generation, then changes to a different supported palette whenever the connected BizHawk client observes Kirby enter a different room (Issue #857). - Added four progression items that independently open the walls controlled by those levers. Pulling a lever now sends its AP location check without opening the wall; receiving the matching Lever Wall item sets the native wall-unlock state instead (Issue #859).
### Improvements - Consolidated `defeat_random_hidden_area_boss` and `defeat_configured_area_boss` into the canonical `defeat_area_boss` goal. `configured_area_boss: random` now uses Archipelago's standard `Choice` randomization, the old `defeat_configured_area_boss` name remains a safe YAML alias, and all eight boss-to-area mappings are corrected (Issue #872). - Generated YAML documentation now shows the scalar `configured_area_boss: random` and `starting_kirby_color: random` shorthands and explains how they replace the generated concrete weight mappings (Issue #872).
### Known Limitations - *NEW* - Enemy Health Scaling: The health bar for enemies does not visually show the changed values. - *NEW* - Kirby Color: random_color_per_room changes Kirby's color, but does not change the corresponding UI element colors. - Localization: Only the North American ROM is supported. All AP notifications are in English. - Progression: The entire game is still only two spheres. This means you can complete almost the entirety of Kirby and the Amazing Mirror without ever having to receive an item, except open the Dimension Mirror. In other words, you can do everything in the game except defeat Dark Mind without ever receiving an item from another player. This is a consequence of the original game design. We have plans to gate your progression in other ways, but they all require coding/hacking in intentional blockers. - Small Chests: We know you want the "small" chests implemented. We want them implemented too. We've been working on it for months. We decided getting out what IS working, is more important. - Sprite Swapping: The animation for getting the original item will play with the original sprite. Statues show the old ability. This is expected. We hope in the future to support "sprite swapping" where we show the sprite for the actual item delivered or ability granted. - Emulator: Only BizHawk is supported. mGBA may work, but we don't currently test against it.
### Bug Fixes
- Boss checks were mapped incorrectly for the `defeat_configured_area_boss` goal. That's been fixed (Issue #893). - Adds cutter to the base ability pool to make sure players can cut the drop down platforms. (Issue #894)
### Internal Changes - Added pinned, checksum-verified Archipelago generation fuzzing with a strict local launcher, a pull-request/manual CI workflow, and retained failure artifacts (Issue #898). - `starting_kirby_color` now uses the same standard Archipelago `Choice` literal `random`; the former world-specific `random_color` sentinel has been removed (Issue #872). - Split Kirby color catalog validation into focused helpers so Flake8 complexity checks remain meaningful without suppressing C901 (Issue #872).

entry.title: Layer8Problem v0.9.3
entry.content:
## Fixed
Phone sidequests ("SMS style" events) never sent a check. handleSideQuest routes every kind: "phone" event into the smartphone UI, which never calls renderTerminal/resolveTerminal — the only place the client listened. 45 of the 99 sidequest chains are phone-only, so nearly half of the sidequest pool was unsendable regardless of the option chosen. The client now hooks openPhone and handlePhoneChoice. Item-find checks were lost whenever the engine skipped addToArchive: a full backpack (10/10) drops the loot and an already-owned permanent item expires silently, yet the player did find it. The client now fires on the loot value of resolveTerminal / the phone result node, wraps inventory.push, and runs a periodic scan over inventory + archive as a safety net. Mod-version drift now only warns when major.minor differ, so a v0.9.2 seed played with the v0.9.3 client no longer shows a warning (IDs are identical).
## Compatibility
Client-only release. Location and item IDs, logic, options and the apworld are unchanged — existing v0.9.2 seeds keep working, no regeneration needed.
